<module id="radix2_div">
    <description>A simplified radix-2 divider for 8-bit signed or unsigned integers.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">The clock signal used for synchronous operation.</input>
        <input id="rst">The reset signal to initialize or reset the module.</input>
        <input id="sign">Indicates if the operation is signed (1) or unsigned (0).</input>
        <input id="dividend" width_description="[7:0]">The 8-bit input signal representing the dividend for division.</input>
        <input id="divisor" width_description="[7:0]">The 8-bit input signal representing the divisor for division.</input>
        <input id="opn_valid">A 1-bit input signal indicating that a valid operation request is present.</input>
        <output id="res_valid">A 1-bit output signal indicating the result is valid and ready.</output>
        <output id="result" width_description="[15:0]">The 16-bit output containing the remainder in the upper 8 bits and the quotient in the lower 8 bits.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="DIVIDE">1'b0</parameter>
        <parameter id="IDLE">1'b1</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <reg id="state" type="enum" values="DIVIDE,IDLE">The current state of the divider.</reg>
        <reg id="next_state" type="enum" values="DIVIDE,IDLE">The next state of the divider.</reg>
        <reg id="start_cnt">Flag to indicate the start of the division process.</reg>
        <reg id="res_valid_reg">Register to hold the result validity flag.</reg>
        <reg id="neg_sign">Flag to indicate negative sign.</reg>
        <reg id="cnt">Counter for the division process.</reg>
        <wire id="sub_result">Wire to hold the result of subtraction.</wire>
        <wire id="carry_out">Wire to hold the carry-out result of subtraction.</wire>
        <wire id="mux_out">Wire to hold the output of the multiplexer.</wire>
        <reg [15:0] id="SR">Shift register to store the dividend and remainder during division.</reg>
        <reg [7:0] id="NEG_DIVISOR">Register to hold the negative value of the divisor.</reg>
        <reg [7:0] id="dividend_abs">Register to hold the absolute value of the dividend.</reg>
        <reg [7:0] id="divisor_abs">Register to hold the absolute value of the divisor.</reg>
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        // State transition logic
        always @(posedge clk or posedge rst) begin
            if(rst) begin
                state <= IDLE;
            end else begin
                state <= next_state;
            end
        end
        
        // Next state logic
        always @(*) begin
            case(state)
                DIVIDE: begin
                    if(cnt == 8) begin
                        next_state = IDLE;
                    end else begin
                        next_state = DIVIDE;
                    end
                end
                IDLE: begin
                    if(opn_valid && !res_valid_reg) begin
                        next_state = DIVIDE;
                    end else begin
                        next_state = IDLE;
                    end
                end
                default: next_state = IDLE;
            endcase
        end
        
        // Output logic
        always @(posedge clk or posedge rst) begin
            if(rst) begin
                res_valid_reg <= 1'b0;
            end else begin
                if(res_valid_reg && cnt != 8) begin
                    res_valid_reg <= 1'b0;
                end else if(next_state == IDLE) begin
                    res_valid_reg <= 1'b1;
                end
            end
        end
        
        // Division logic
        always @(posedge clk or posedge rst) begin
            if(rst) begin
                start_cnt <= 1'b0;
                cnt <= 1'b0;
                SR <= 16'd0;
                NEG_DIVISOR <= 8'd0;
                dividend_abs <= 8'd0;
                divisor_abs <= 8'd0;
                neg_sign <= 1'b0;
            end else begin
                if(opn_valid && !res_valid_reg) begin
                    dividend_abs <= (sign & dividend[7]) ? (~dividend + 1) : dividend;
                    divisor_abs <= (sign & divisor[7]) ? (~divisor + 1) : divisor;
                    SR <= {dividend_abs, 1'b0};
                    NEG_DIVISOR <= ~(divisor_abs) + 1;
                    cnt <= 1'b1;
                    start_cnt <= 1'b1;
                    neg_sign <= ((sign & dividend[7]) ^ (sign & divisor[7])) & (divisor != 0);
                end else if(start_cnt) begin
                    if(cnt[7]) begin
                        start_cnt <= 1'b0;
                        cnt <= 1'b0;
                        SR <= {sub_result[7:0], mux_out};
                    end else begin
                        cnt <= cnt + 1;
                        SR <= {sub_result[7:0], mux_out};
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        
        // Subtraction logic
        assign sub_result = SR[15:8] + NEG_DIVISOR;
        
        // Multiplexer logic
        assign mux_out = (sub_result[8]) ? SR[7:0] : sub_result[7:0];
        
        // Assign outputs
        assign res_valid = res_valid_reg;
        assign result = (neg_sign) ? ~{SR[15:8]+1, SR[7:0]}+1 : {SR[15:8], SR[7:0]};
    </implementation>
    
</module>
